description: trust-no-agent router hooks — (1) inject the discipline floor (Iron Laws + MANDATORY section) at session start and after compaction, so the rules survive a harness that drops the router; (2) classify each user prompt against the MANDATORY domains mechanically (scripts/mandatory-gate.mjs) and inject a LOAD directive when a domain is touched. The classifier is a keyword signal, never a hard gate (docs/specs/mandatory-gate.md).
